scope: Overlap-adjusted observed occupied time, separate from summed call intervals, per MCP/Skill/outer category

contract.fields: Optional ToolUsageReport.timingSummaries, one aggregate per category; no interval arrays or source identifiers exported
contract.occupiedTime: Union of usable start/end intervals; overlapping or nested ranges count once, gaps excluded
contract.selectedCalls: Same start/observedAt window selection as existing rows; only endSeen pairs with start and end inside the window and finite nonnegative duration contribute timing
contract.unknowns: No usable pairs means unknown seconds, not zero; incomplete, reversed or out-of-window pairs remain in callsWithoutUsableTiming
contract.boundaries: No clipping or extrapolation of partial calls; categories not summed together; host invocation-failure pairs still included
contract.legacyReports: Missing aggregate fields stay unavailable; row sums cannot reconstruct overlaps
contract.validation: Reject duplicate, inconsistent, row-count-mismatched or out-of-window aggregates for display; preserve fractional timestamps

validation.configuration: Debug module suite, compiled native CLI and actual SwiftUI panel offscreen rendering; no App/Release rebuild

ownedCLIFixture.sharedTimestampPrecision: Exact whole seconds for both ISO/native fixture representations; production fractional offsets independently tested

realReplay.independentOracle: Decimal millisecond endpoints, sweep active-call count; production merges interval ranges
realReplay.boundary: Bounded completed native MCP items with start/end in the window. Not complete logs, missing-call frequency, CPU time, task duration, causal efficiency or billing.

validation.offscreenUI: Chinese occupied time, summed time, coverage and scope note visually checked against a synthetic report

boundaries: Only observed intervals in selected logs; source tails were clipped, so not complete activity or a missing-call rate
Time between a first start and last end is not used as occupied time; idle gaps excluded
Not service CPU time, end-to-end task duration, latency improvement, causal efficiency or billing
No existing row medians, P95s, sums, error/status, text bytes or token counters changed in the paired replay
No model/business/hardware call, active App install, package rebuild or publication
